title: Resonant Collinearity
description: Find antinode positions from antenna pair resonance on a grid.
writeup:
## Approach

Group antennas by their frequency character. For each pair of same-frequency antennas, compute antinode positions along the line connecting them.

## Part 1

For each pair (A, B), the two antinodes are at positions that extend the line segment by exactly one step beyond each endpoint: `A - (B-A)` and `B + (B-A)`. Count distinct in-bounds positions.

## Part 2

Antinodes now appear at *every* grid-aligned point along the line through each antenna pair, including the antennas themselves. Walk in both directions from one antenna using the step vector until leaving the grid.
